title: fleet-write rerun_failed: hotcrm's link checker is .github/workflows/link-check.yml, which the relay's workflow fence (ci.yml, check-links.yml) refuses, so a seat cannot re-run a transient link-check failure on hotcrm
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcV3h25dAMNWki8e1ns

**Measured 2026-11-25 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm PR #2795, head `061cbd50`.**
- **The failure:** the `Link Check` run 45600157624 (`.github/workflows/link-check.yml`, `pull_request`, attempt 1) failed on one link that answered GitHub `502`: `https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/pull/2478`. Fetched directly, that PR answers; it is closed. The link was already in the edited file.
- **The refusal:** `node scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs --run 45600157624 --repo objectstack-ai/hotcrm` answered `REFUSED before the dispatch — fence workflow`. The run's path is not in `RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS` (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs:1249`: `ci.yml`, `check-links.yml`). Nothing was sent.
- **Why:** `check-links.yml` is objectstack's link workflow. hotcrm names its own `link-check.yml` (`git ls-tree origin/main .github/workflows/` on hotcrm). The fence is one repo-agnostic path list, so the hotcrm link checker it was presumably meant to admit never matches.

**Effect:** hotcrm's AGENTS.md lets a seat land a reviewer-class PR only when every check finished green. A transient link 502 therefore parks a ready PR until a human re-runs it in the Actions UI or a later push re-triggers it; empty commits are not allowed.

**For the owner of `scripts/pm/fleet-write/`:**
- Either the fence becomes per-repo (objectstack `check-links.yml`, hotcrm `link-check.yml`), or the hotcrm path is added to the list.
- The self-tests in `validate.mjs:1757` and `rerun-failed.mjs:472` pin the list as it is, so they change with it.
- Which one is the owner's call; this card only reports the mismatch.

Filed as `finding` for first grading. ⛔ Not a claim.
